diagnostics.message: module.cloudtrail_baseline creates the aws_cloudtrail trail, which validates the S3 bucket policy at creation time (AWS returns InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException if the policy granting cloudtrail.amazonaws.com access isn't applied yet). It only receives local.audit_log_bucket_id (the bucket id), so nothing orders it after resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log. Add a depends_on on the audit log bucket policy.

module.config_baseline_ap-northeast-1 creates an aws_config_delivery_channel pointing at the audit log bucket (via s3_bucket_name). AWS Config validates that the bucket policy grants config.amazonaws.com write access when the delivery channel is created (InsufficientDeliveryPolicyException), but the module has no dependency on resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log. Add a depends_on on the audit log bucket policy.

resource.aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization references only the role ARN (aws_iam_role.config_organization[0].arn). AWS validates at aggregator creation time that the organization aggregation source role has the AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations policy attached; the attachment resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization is created in parallel and the aggregator can be created before it, causing the API call to fail. Add a depends_on on the role policy attachment (the provider docs show exactly this pattern).

module.vpc_baseline_ap-northeast-1 creates aws_flow_log.default_vpc_flow_logs using the VPC flow logs publisher role ARN, but the role's publish policy (resource.aws_iam_role_policy.vpc_flow_logs_publish_policy, created in the root module) is not a dependency. VPC Flow Logs requires the role to already have the logs:CreateLogStream/logs:PutLogEvents permissions attached when the flow log is created, otherwise log delivery fails. Add a depends_on on the publisher role policy.
